RESULT (primary прогон выполнен; артефакт analysis/q10_least_used.py; seed=20261022; 10 000 bootstrap-реплик)

ИТОГОВАЯ ГИПОТЕЗА (natural language):
"BDD scenarios and ML Canvas are the two least used named documentation formats for requirements in ML-enabled system projects. Among the 194 respondents who answered Q10, only 2.06% (95% bootstrap CI [0.52, 4.12]) reported using BDD scenarios and 7.73% (95% CI [4.12, 11.86]) reported using ML Canvas, versus 34.02% for notebooks and 32.47% for user stories. Mapping the question's figures by magnitude, the first-named value 10.13% [9.926, 10.333] corresponds to ML Canvas (our 7.73%, the larger of the pair) and the second-named value 4.366% [4.231, 4.501] corresponds to BDD scenarios (our 2.06%, the smallest of all formats). Bootstrapping confirms the rank rather than the exact level: BDD scenarios is in the bottom two in 100.0% of 10 000 replicates and ML Canvas in 97.8%, while every other format is below 1.4%."

PRIMARY — 10 именованных форматов, N = 194 (дошедшие до Q10; −77 аллорельно у 82 из 276), по возрастанию usage share:
1 BDD_Scenarios 4/194 2.062 [0.515, 4.124] P(bottom-2)=1.000
2 MLCanvas 15/194 7.732 [4.124, 11.856] P=0.978
3 Vision_Document 29/194 14.948 [10.309, 20.103] P=0.013
4 Goal_Models 29/194 14.948 [10.309, 20.103] P=0.008
5 Data_Models 34/194 17.526 [12.371, 23.196] P=0.001
6 Use_Case_Models 38/194 19.588 [13.918, 25.258] P=0.000
7 Prototypes 42/194 21.649 [15.979, 27.320] P=0.000
8 Requirements_Lists 51/194 26.289 [20.103, 32.474] P=0.000
9 User_Stories 63/194 32.474 [26.289, 39.175] P=0.000
10 Notebooks 66/194 34.021 [27.320, 40.722] P=0.000

TRANSPARENCY (all 12 coded columns, N=194) — ничья не спрятана:
BDD 4 2.062% P=1.000 | MLCanvas 15 7.732% P=0.526 | Others 15 7.732% P=0.468 | Vision 29 14.948% | Goal 29 14.948% | Not_Documented 30 15.464% [10.825, 20.619] P=0.003 | Data_Models 34 | Use_Case 38 | Prototypes 42 | Req_Lists 51 | User_Stories 63 | Notebooks 66.
Второй слот буквально определяется тем, что Others не считается форматом: identical 15/194 = 7.732%, в репликах слот делится ~53/47. Not_Documented (30/194 = 15.464%) — констатация отсутствия документации, справочно, вне ранкинга.

SENSITIVITY (sensitivity, не primary; пороги не подбирались под якоря):
Status≠Suspended N=188: 2.128 / 7.979 / 7.979 | Duration>300s N=157: 2.548 / 8.917 / 8.917 | >600s N=146: 2.740 / 8.219 / 8.904 | >1000s N=103: 3.883 / 8.738 / 10.680 | >1120s N=91: 4.396 / 5.495 / 9.890 (порядок: BDD / MLCanvas / Others). BDD минимален во всех подвыборках.

КОНТР-АРГУМЕНТ (в отдельном блоке скрипта, primary не меняет): при жёстких Duration-порогах якорь 10.13% ближе к Others, чем к ML Canvas: >1000s |d| 1.392 (MLCanvas) vs 0.550 (Others); >1120s |d| 4.635 vs 0.240, при этом BDD 4.396% почти совпадает с 4.366% (|d| = 0.030). Если бы эталон считал Others форматом, пара была бы {BDD scenarios, Other/unspecified}.

ТОЧНОСТЬ VS ЭТАЛОН (строки из вывода): implied n = p(1-p)(1.96/h)^2 → 88,012 для 4.366% [4.231,4.501] и 84,452 для 10.13% [9.926,10.333] против нашего n=194. CI эталона ±0.14–0.20 п.п. несовместимы с бутстрапом пропорции при n≤194 (наши ±2–4 п.п.) — точное совпадение недостижимо, наши CI шире по построению.

ПОРЯДОК ОТВЕТА: первый названный формат (10.13%) — больший из пары → ML Canvas; второй (4.366%) — меньший → BDD Scenarios.

ПОВТОРИМОСТЬ: скрипт детерминирован (default_rng(20261022)), два прогона → идентичный md5 таблицы и идентичные primary-таблицы. Окружение: python 3.12.14, pandas 3.0.2, numpy 2.4.4.

payload.hypothesis: BDD scenarios and ML Canvas are the two least used named documentation formats for requirements in ML-enabled system projects. Among the 194 respondents who answered Q10, only 2.06% (95% bootstrap CI [0.52, 4.12]) used BDD scenarios and 7.73% (95% CI [4.12, 11.86]) used ML Canvas, compared with 34.02% for notebooks and 32.47% for user stories. Mapping the question's figures by magnitude, the first-named 10.13% [9.926, 10.333] corresponds to ML Canvas (our 7.73%, the larger of the pair) and the second-named 4.366% [4.231, 4.501] to BDD scenarios (our 2.06%, the smallest format of all); bootstrapping supports the rank, not the exact level - BDD is bottom-2 in 100.0% of 10,000 replicates and ML Canvas in 97.8%, while every other format is below 1.4%. Caveat: ML Canvas is tied at 15/194 (7.73%) with the free-text Others basket, so the second slot depends on not counting Others as a format, and the reference CIs (implied n ~ 85,000) cannot be reproduced at n = 194.
payload.workflow: 1) Load CSV (276 respondents, unique IDs); assert Q10 encodings are only quoted / not quoted / -77. 2) Treat -77, -66, -99, -1, NaN as missing and exclude them (never summed); the Q10 block is all-or-nothing missing for 82 respondents, so the primary sample is the 194 Q10 answerers, unit = respondent. 3) Indicator used = value equals quoted; metric = usage share = used / 194 (the complement is 66-98% and cannot match the question's magnitudes; no Likert levels exist in this export). 4) Rank the 10 named formats ascending, with Not_Documented and the free-text Others shown only as reference rows plus a full 12-column table so the MLCanvas/Others 15/194 tie is visible. 5) Non-parametric bootstrap over respondents, B = 10000, numpy default_rng(20261022), percentile 2.5/97.5, no stratification; rank significance = bottom-2 inclusion probability across replicates. 6) Sensitivity section (not primary, never used to pick the answer): Status != Suspended and Duration > 300/600/1000/1120 s, plus an explicit counter-argument block showing that under strict duration filters the 10.13% anchor sits closer to Others than to ML Canvas. 7) Anchor check: implied n from the reference CIs = p(1-p)(1.96/h)^2 = 88012 and 84452 vs n = 194, so exact CI agreement is unattainable. 8) Print tables and the hypothesis; rerun verified byte-identical (md5 of the output table).
